Malawian district officials in Rwanda for study tour

A delegation of 18 district commissioners and council officials from Malawi is in Rwanda for a study tour running from 9-14 March 2026, organised with Rwanda Cooperation.

The visitors met officials at the Ministry of Local Government (MINALOC) and the Rwanda Governance Board to learn how performance contracts, known as Imihigo, are negotiated between districts and the central government. They also took part in Umuganda, the monthly community work day.

The head of the delegation said Malawi is reforming decentralisation and local revenue collection, and wanted to see how Rwandan districts plan and report on budgets.

The programme includes a field visit to Musanze District and a meeting with RALGA.
